entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • ValidationContext.ObjectInstance references the root model instead of the nested object when validating complex object graphs #67499
  • Consider using Microsoft.CodeAnalysis 4.x or later #67494
  • Fix tests that use AppContextSwitch #67491
    11.0-preview7
  • `TypedResults.ValidationProblem` doesn't serialize the `errors` property if `AddProblemDetails` is called after `AddControllers` #67487
  • Include the LICENSE file in the published @microsoft/signalr and @microsoft/signalr-protocol-msgpack npm packages #67486
    11.0-preview7
  • 'Unable to connect to 'https'' when running Blazor WebAssembly Standalone project with https #67484
  • Perf improvement: antiforgery-noop, https, mvc #67480
  • Sending more than 32K to localstorage Then Reading It Causes Circuit Deadlock #67479

Closed

  • The fwlink for https://aka.ms/aspnetcore/11.0-third-party-notices is incorrect , navigate to the wrong branch 11.0-preview1 #67482
  • Quarantine QuickGridNoInteractivityTest class #66883
  • [dotnet-sdk-11.0.100-preview.6.26325.125] HackSystem login failed with "Access to XMLHttpRequest has been blocked by CORS policy" and "System.InvalidOperationException" errors #67424
  • AmbiguousMatchException using .AddValidation() #64728
    .NET 11 Planning
